def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with pathlib.Path(p).open("rb") as f:

def inspect(row):
    p=pathlib.Path(row["path"]); s=p.lstat()

    assert s.st_size==row["bytes"] and digest==row["sha256"], str(p)
    if "version" in row: assert json.loads(p.read_bytes())["version"]==row["version"]
